from pathlib import Path

import bibtexparser
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display


PUBLICATIONS_SOURCE = Path("assets/publications.bib")
with PUBLICATIONS_SOURCE.open(encoding="utf-8-sig") as bib_file:
    bib_database = bibtexparser.load(bib_file)

records = [
    {
        "key": entry["ID"],
        "year": int(entry["year"]) if "year" in entry else None,
        "status": entry["pubstatus"],
        "type": entry["pubtype"],
        "author": entry.get("author", ""),
        "title": entry.get("title", ""),
        "venue": entry.get(
            "journal", entry.get("booktitle", entry.get("howpublished", ""))
        ),
        "doi": entry.get("doi"),
        "url": entry.get("url"),
        "note": entry.get("note"),
    }
    for entry in sorted(bib_database.entries, key=lambda item: item["ID"])
]
df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Year": [record["year"] for record in records],
        "Publication Type": [record["type"] for record in records],
        "Status": [record["status"] for record in records],
    }
)

pub_type_order = ["Journal", "Conference", "Magazine", "Presentation", "Poster"]
df["Publication Type"] = pd.Categorical(
    df["Publication Type"], categories=pub_type_order, ordered=True
)
counts = (
    df[df["Status"] == "published"]
    .groupby(["Year", "Publication Type"], observed=False)
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="Count")
)
published_df = df[df["Status"] == "published"]

journal_count = (published_df["Publication Type"] == "Journal").sum()
conference_count = (published_df["Publication Type"] == "Conference").sum()
presentations_total = published_df["Publication Type"].isin(
    ["Conference", "Poster", "Presentation"]
).sum()

grid_html = f"""
<div class="pub-counts-grid" style="margin: 0.5rem 0;">
  <div style="text-align: center;"><h1 style="font-size: 3rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--bs-primary); margin-bottom: 0; line-height: 1;">{journal_count}</h1><p style="font-size: 1rem; margin: 0;">Journal Articles</p></div>
  <div style="text-align: center;"><h1 style="font-size: 3rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--bs-primary); margin-bottom: 0; line-height: 1;">{conference_count}</h1><p style="font-size: 1rem; margin: 0;">Conference Papers</p></div>
  <div style="text-align: center;"><h1 style="font-size: 3rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--bs-primary); margin-bottom: 0; line-height: 1;">{presentations_total}</h1><p style="font-size: 1rem; margin: 0;">Presentations</p></div>
</div>
"""
display(HTML(grid_html))

fig = px.bar(
    counts,
    x="Year",
    y="Count",
    color="Publication Type",
    color_discrete_sequence=["#220025", "#6a346f", "#80008c", "#a900b9", "#b558bd"],
    category_orders={"Publication Type": pub_type_order},
    barmode="group",
    title="Publications by Year and Type",
)
fig.update_layout(
    legend=dict(
        x=0.02,
        y=0.98,
        xanchor="left",
        yanchor="top",
        bgcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)",
        bordercolor="rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
        borderwidth=1,
    )
)
fig.show()

badge_styles = {
    "Journal": ("#220025ff", "#220025ff"),
    "Conference": ("#6a346fff", "#6a346fff"),
    "Magazine": ("#80008cff", "#80008cff"),
    "Presentation": ("#a900b9ff", "#a900b9ff"),
    "Poster": ("#b558bdff", "#b558bdff"),
}

sections = []
for section_name in ["in review"] + sorted(
    {record["year"] for record in records if record["year"] is not None},
    reverse=True,
):
    section_records = [
        record
        for record in records
        if (record["status"] == "in review" and section_name == "in review")
        or (record["year"] == section_name)
    ]
    if not section_records:
        continue

    heading = "In review" if section_name == "in review" else str(section_name)
    css_class = "in-review" if section_name == "in review" else str(section_name)
    entries = [f"## {heading}", f"::: {{.{css_class}}}"]
    for record in section_records:
        border, color = badge_styles[record["type"]]
        badge = (
            '<span class="badge rounded-pill" '
            f'style="background-color:transparent; border:1px solid {border}; '
            f'color:{color};"> {record["type"]} </span>'
        )
        date = f" ({record['year']})." if record["year"] else ""
        citation = f"{record['author']}{date} {record['title']}."
        if record["venue"]:
            citation += f" *{record['venue']}*."
        if record["note"]:
            citation += f" {record['note']}"
        if record["doi"]:
            citation += f" DOI: [{record['doi']}](https://doi.org/{record['doi']})."
        elif record["url"]:
            citation += f" [[Link]({record['url']})]"
        entries.append(f"1. {badge} {citation}")
    entries.extend(["", r"^\*^Student Author; ^‡^Invited Talk", ":::"])
    sections.append("\n".join(entries))

display(Markdown("\n\n".join(sections)))
